examples.en: Who gave you the right to say I had a one-night stand with Vivian?
examples.zh: 你凭什么说我跟薇薇安一夜情？

examples.en: Did you already know Luo Ping brought Vivian back? Is that why you showed up at my place so suddenly yesterday?
examples.zh: 你是不是早就知道罗平把薇薇安找回来了？所以昨天你才会突然出现在我家。
